Evelyn Zhang张煜玮

Publications also appear under Yuwei Zhang

Exploring efficient visual intelligence.

My research focuses on computer vision, multimodal learning, and diffusion models. I am interested in making generative and multimodal systems more efficient through token pruning, feature caching, and better use of visual information.

VISION / GENERATION / EFFICIENCY
01 / A little about me

My work spans efficient diffusion inference, multimodal token selection, and robust visual understanding. Across these topics, I explore how models can retain useful information while reducing redundant computation.

Affiliation listed on Google Scholar: Tongji University.

02 / RESEARCH

Research interests

Three connected directions.

01

Efficient generation

Token pruning and feature caching for diffusion models and transformers.

02

Multimodal intelligence

Visual token selection, multimodal reasoning, and efficient attention.

03

Robust visual understanding

Image enhancement, restoration, and visual perception under degradations.
